steps.name: Voice on the Television
steps.text: A breakout from the underground arena, two stages advanced in the preliminaries... a challenger with outstanding skill, Infected knight, 'Wild Mane' Iwona Krukowska...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: 'Wild Mane?'

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What is it, Sona?

steps.name: Voice on the Television
steps.text: ...however, caused an improper altercation with other knights in the rest quarters, and was violent in the confrontation...

steps.name: Voice on the Television
steps.text: ...may face a 'suspension'...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Here it goes again. Another report on the dark side of Infected knights.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: 'Improper altercation.' Hah, do you have to imagine? It can't have been anything but losers hooting at the winner.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: When it's Infected knights competing, they'll say shit as bad they want to say.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You saw that clip of the match just now, Ashley. This Kuranta's... got some skills.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Her style's pretty distinct from those flower-show nobles, yeah, but she's still a ways off from the top tiers.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Mmm...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You wanna recruit her?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I've heard about her before... some of the knightclub knows her.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: What are we still looking for? 'The team leader needs real skill and overpowering force.' Your words, Ashley.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I wanna test our luck. Every independent knight is getting scouted by knightclub agents. If we invite her as an Infected knightclub, that oughta catch her interest.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I've got a feeling she's the one we're looking for.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Are you interested in her skill, or do you think she shares our agenda?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: That's what'cha find out in your a little chat.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Firstly, you need a chance to meet and talk at all. You heard it on the news. The K.G.C.C. is considering handing her a 'suspension'. That's not something you settle with a flick of the wrist.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: The prelims just started, she's an Infected, and she's green for an independent knight. No one's going to be able to help her.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: And what if we actually could, this time?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You need to think this through properly, Sona. It's a risky gamble. If she's already firm on riding this down to the end, we're going to be rivals.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: But... if you need to talk to her, it's going to be worth all our strength trying. Where Pinus Sylvestris is right now, every new ally is crucial.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We oughta try and see. If we can get our point across... then things being what they are, I'm pretty sure she'll want to do a little something for the Infected.
Some days later...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Tch. Nobody in the K.G.C.C. wants to hear the facts. If you don't want a fair ruling in the first place, why get all sanctimonious blabbing at me?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hff... damn, it hurts. Police batons got way more oomph than all that third-rate noble crap. Way I see it, they might as well put those guards up to fight a round or two. Lords in the audiences would love to see that...
She's out, she's out!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: Wild Mane Knight, does leaving the General Chamber of Commerce mean the government's already made their ruling?

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: What are your thoughts on the dispute you had with the knights in the lounge? Was it an act of provocation?

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: Is it fair to the other knights to have you, an Infected knight, using the same facilities?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Get out of my face! All of you!

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: You need to answer our questions, Wild Mane Knight! Also, just what pretext did you use for the General Chamber of Commerce to let you slip out...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Aaarrrrghhh, who the hell d'you think you are?!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Oh, here she is.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hah, hah... huh?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Were you... waiting for me?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I saw that scene at the entrance coming a mile away. You only had a few choices, and one of them was here. Unless... you wanted to bust your way out.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Looks like you've got it now though. The further you are from the camera, the better. Let me introduce myself...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: No need, I know you. Big cannon-toter, and there's the other one with the sword. You two Zalaks are partners, and you're good enough in a fight.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I'll take that as a compliment.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ashlock, right? Are you here to pick a fight? Or just make fun of me?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: We knew you were walking into a mess. So we came to offer help, in case you need.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ohh. Such as?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Take those reporters, not to mention some of the agents around with ulterior motives. We can help you turn them all down.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Who are you guys?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I'll take that one.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: If you already know us and what we do, then this'll go a lot easier.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We keep a keen eye on the Infected knights. So when we saw on TV the kind of trouble you were getting into, we came up with a little plan...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Could you just come out and say it already? Complicated talk is just gonna hurt my head. What do you want out of me?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: To put it straight, we're in charge of the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub. If you believe in the same things we do, then I want you to join us.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Pinus Sylvestris? Never heard of it.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We're a new knightclub, mostly Infected knights...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...Infected?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You think you'll make more money with a club full of Infected knights barely clinging to life? Ha, must be paradise and a half in your head.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No! We're not like the clubs who use Infected as a moneymaking sideshow. We're all about mutual aid between Infected.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: And how's that gonna work?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The first part... we'll improve the treatment of Infected knights in the Major. That's the idea.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We all know how the Infected in the other clubs end up. All the money they promise is a scam, and their minimum bet is your life.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ha. I bet all the Infected who fought their way through the arena want to ask: when's a single day go by without betting your life?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: When those noble knight families lose, at least they've still got a home to trot back to with their tails between their legs...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Infected? If you want status, you head into that nightmare of an underground arena with everyone else and lose your mind scrambling for a knight title.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: And just suppose you live through it. How long's your career, how far do you go? That's all for the moneybags to decide. They just wanna see you bleed.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Beat you half to death? Not enough for 'em. What those lunatic scumbags want to see in their heart of hearts is—

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Wild Mane, let's not.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ugh. I know. Just venting.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: No point talking about all this, anyway. What I need is someplace I can fix my weapon. I can do better than this beat-up hunk of junk shelled lance.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Uh, we may not have a real certified weapon specialist yet, but we could always hire a professional...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: In other words, if I join, I get some basic benefits?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Right, salary... we can just about pay you like another knightclub. But, you know, our aim's always been...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Then I'm joining.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I said, I'm joining. I don't know what your Infected knightclub's gonna be like, but it's gotta beat any other choice.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I've seen the eyes of the uninfected knights staring at us and I'm through with it. I'm not associating with any of those chuckleheads.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Before I became a knight, survival was top priority, and everything was for getting fed. Ever since becoming a knight... that hasn't changed much.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I don't wanna put up with all that just to eat. If your thing can keep my stomach from running empty, and there's no old noble knightheads to make me throw up, then I'm with you for now.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: In that case, you want to get paid how much...?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (Holds out three fingers)

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Three?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Money for three days' food, and the funds to fix my weapon. I'm taking that match the day after tomorrow, and when I get that prize money, I'll pay you back, and then I'm officially splitting the rest with you.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The K.G.C.C. wanted bail before they'd let me out. Their stupid fine was so precise, it was my bank balance straight up—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: If anyone could get the number, it'd be them.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: So, right now, I'm penniless, and I'm starving. No objections there?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: None at all. I can give you an advance here, and when you're done with that pressing stuff, come see us at the knightclub.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Now we're talking. Tell me the address. I'm gonna need your base tomorrow so I can practice how I'm gonna bust clean through the armor of that jackass who had words for me—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Alright, I'll spar with you.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Deal, see you there. If you renege on me, I'm coming to find you and you'd better believe I'll settle the score!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: What's up, Ashley? You've been eyeing me this whole time.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You seriously... just gave her cash, had her join, and let her go? My guess is she doesn't even get why the K.G.C.C. let her walk out of that building in the first place.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Haha, fixing your weapon's gotta be number one when you're a battle maniac! She's been slammed up for days, and there's no way she's talking serious business first thing.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: And besides, we've got no time to explain things to her right now, we just came by with a few words. We've got other stuff going on.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: So you're saying you don't think there's a way to wrap this up quick, and you'll be in a better place to chat her up tomorrow?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: All we can do is stay on guard. It depends on if they leave the neighborhood Infected alone tonight...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Wishful thinking.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I know. That's exactly why this is something we have to do right now. I'll sort out the stuff with Wild Mane later, trust me.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Fine, whatever. I mean, your instinct wasn't wrong. Wild Mane sure is interesting.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Oh? Where's this coming from?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: The way she sees things... is kind of like how I used to. She might be more blunt... but she's got none of that excess baggage.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Pffhaha. That's just what I need, you two finding common ground.
The next day...
An abandoned office building entrance

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: This is the place, right? This dump... is this seriously a knightclub?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Whatever, just in case. I might as well go in and ask...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hey, are the Flametail or Ashlock Knights in here—

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: Looking for the leader?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Yeah, I'm here to check in.

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: I'm surprised someone actually came knocking... Unfortunately, they just left on business... Why are you carrying luggage?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I'm surprised myself. What's got this place so strapped for cash? You don't even have a sofa?

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: Award money's ample for knights, true... but Sona and her crew use most of it to settle Infected.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Oh, I see. Thing is, I just got kicked out by my landlord, so I've only got my knightclub for shelter.

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: Put your luggage down for now, and we can work out what to do once the leader's back.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Speaking of, are they this busy all the time? Where do they drill?

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: There's a lot of work-related communication that needs handling.

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: Audits against Knightclubs for Infected knights are getting stricter. The Flametail and Ashlock Knights are constantly talking with the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi and the Grand Knight Territory.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: *yawn* That's bureaucrats for you, all image. I thought at least there'd be proper eats for my initiation ceremony. Ashlock sure seemed like she could handle her drink.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Speaking of Ashlock, where's she put her cannon? I've been wanting to check it out. With a 'baaang' like that, and that truckload of destructive power...

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: Er, her weapon's... probably at home.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You're duping me.

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: Huh? Nuh-uh...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I can tell. You're hiding something from me.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What, scared to tell me where Flametail and Ashlock are right now? They're up to something outside of the Major for sure. Sensed as much during our conversation last night.

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: The leader did warn me someone might be coming, but the rest isn't... for me to tell you.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: If she doesn't want you telling me, why wouldn't they wait until I came before they left?

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: They...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Something's definitely pressing on 'em, and that's what's keeping 'em away from here. It can't be anything good.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ha, I was right!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I knew it. It couldn't have been that simple when they came looking for me. You're up to some risky business, aren't you?

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: If Flametail and Ashlock made the right call... then they—no, we—want you to lend us your power.

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: Oh, and there's the other thing... they put up some extra money to rescue you.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...Can you repeat that?

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: They wouldn't have wanted you to know. Not every member agrees with how our leader's going about things. She saw the news report about you, and decided to try getting you out.

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: Since the deal even got made, there must have been conditions attached...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Stop. I don't wanna owe 'em favors. If that's really how it's going down, I'm mad as hell, because I've got some responsibility for this too.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Fess up. Where'd they go?

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: They went to a neighborhood with an Infected settlement, to scatter them before they're taken away.

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: Wait, Wild Mane!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What now?

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: Flametail and Ashlock, they're both exceptionally kind, honest knights. I'm certain they want to recruit you because they know you're like us...

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: They're not just Infected knights, they're people who want to change the lot of the Infected in Kazimierz.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: And what does that mean?

steps.name: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Member
steps.text: When you... see their efforts, you'll understand.
Over there—over there—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Don't worry, just get behind me...

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Come out, Infected! You can't run!

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: *whimper*... I'm sorry... I... I'm not bad... don't take me...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Calm down, I'll keep them away. Are you all hidden, kid?

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: Yeah... Miss, I—I'm scared... where's... mom and dad...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I'll protect you, just like your mom and dad did. Trust me, okay? Once I call for you to come out, we'll find somewhere new to live, together.

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: Miss... I want to go home...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Keep quiet a sec.

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: Mmm...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Right then.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Phew. C'mere—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Yo.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Huh?! You—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: ...Wild Mane?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Found you this fast and all I had was a wisp of a clue, and I got here quicker than that gray Zalak did. No slouch, am I?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You really did track us down.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You're protecting this kid? He's Infected?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What, you're gonna hide a kid here? That's a whole five hunters. If just one of 'em succeeds, then he's lost before you even try to get him back.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We... we're too short-handed right now. This is the most we can do.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Mm-hm. So, this is what you're really up to?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Yeah. That's about the size of it.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You're not just in for Infected knights. You guys are helping out more Infected besides, aren't you?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: That's the deal.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ha... and that's why you only recruit Infected knights. Because only the Infected would sympathize with Infected.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Everyone keeps the same secret, has the same wish, even though it seems... totally head-on with those competition knights, yeah?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Yeah. Wild Mane, I don't have time to give you the whole story right now, so if you want out...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Why? I think this is majorly cool.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Yeah, no time. But before anything else, Flametail, I want you to seriously, truly invite me one more time.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You mean... you've decided to do this with us?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ha. What, am I not just like you?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Alright... I get it.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Wild Mane, are you willing to become a member of the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, to aid and be aided as an Infected knight, and to give your all, as we all do, for the sake of the Infected?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Wild Mane? Sorry, I messed that up, didn't I. I never feel like that speech quite works for me...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Call me Iwona.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I'm the Wild Mane Knight, Iwona Krukowska.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ha. Alright, you're calling me Sona then.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Sure, Sona. I, Iwona, as a new inductee to the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, will serve as a knight to seize glory, and to achieve our ideals.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: And my ideals—Sona, if Pinus Sylvestris can change the lot of the Infected, and protect the people... then together with you, I'm going for broke.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Going for broke... yeah, that's exactly the right choice of words here.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But it's not time to stake our lives just yet. We can't leave this kid alone. You're the leader, and it'll be too risky if anyone sees you in an alley doing this stuff.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Just get the kid out of here for now, and I'll handle things here.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Watch close, see what I'm really capable of—wait, no, you oughta go first. Watch another time, then!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Get out of here! By the time you've got the kid dropped off safe, I'll probably be on my way back to find you.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Got it. Don't make this a scene though. Settle it slick, and we'll be waiting for you at the real Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub camp!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: No sweat.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Phew... kept'cha waiting, huh, Ashley...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Good going, Sona. All done?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: For the time being. Say, where's Iwona... uh, Wild Mane?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Seems she went off reminiscing with Jamie...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Here you were, I got back forever ago. Wanted to ask Jamie for a drink, but there's no good booze anywhere around here.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: How's this, then. You get the prize money, and I'll treat you to a round.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ha, done.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I'll join too then.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Nah.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: 'Scuse me? Why won'tcha let me in on this?! What, you guys already have stuff to talk behind my back?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Do you even have time? There's a mountain of paperwork from the Knights Association...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Agh... don't remind me.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: We'll just be belly-aching the whole time, and you hate that stuff. Besides, you're not that good with liquor, and you don't like staying at bars all night.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ugh... no lie. If that's what you're planning, you're your own.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Right, Iwona, if you're not busy, there's a few things I need to tell you about, regarding a few projects Pinus Sylvestris has going...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Those, yeah? Greynuty just told me about 'em.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Rescuing Infected, and Infected knights, and using prize money to help more Infected get legal identities...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Huh, you're all wised up already... so, what'cha think?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: All the prize money I earn can go to you guys. I was training to become a campaign knight. Never thought about doing this to earn big bucks. If it wasn't for... ugh.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Whatever. But in terms of the, uh, more detailed plans, I didn't actually get any of it.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Greynuty said, what Pinus Sylvestris is gonna do for the Infected, how we should do it... you do all that planning.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: So I get it now. You can think this stuff through and put it into practice. That's mad mighty.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Mmm—it's not all that mighty, heh...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I've been thinking about doing something for the Infected forever... just like the Blood Knight! He does some good, fine stuff.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The Blood Knight reformed the Major's regulations, but us... Pinus Sylvestris looks to bring together a big group, form an even greater bloc, and do even more for the Infected.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Then I'm definitely part of it.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: So it's settled, I'll follow you all the way. I believe you're what's right, and whatever bigger challenges come, I'll be there to help you deal with 'em.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But, if you can help me sort out a few problems of my own first, I'll worship you all the more.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Heheh. If it'll win more trust, of course I'm happy to do it. What'cha need helping with?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Uh... what's this?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: My pet.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Peeehhh... pet?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: A pet, huh... that's... it's pretty cute! Iwona, how'd you come across it?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ha, just saw it in a dump by the roadside, felt like I could get some use. They say you know a reliable engineer or some sort?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Engineer? I don't know what kind you're talking about...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Oh, I think there are a few in the neighborhood who know their machine stuff.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Just a bit ago you were having hell finding a weapons repair guy, but now you've got people who understand these machines? What's the deal?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Haha... well, he might take an interest in your weapon too. Should I take you?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Whatever, I'll take it over myself. You and Greynuty have other stuff to talk about, so go get chattering. Where's that engineer live?

steps.name: Infected Knight-Engineer
steps.text: ...I see now. This fine outer hull and internal design...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: How is it? Good stuff, right? This weapon's been with me for years now.

steps.name: Infected Knight-Engineer
steps.text: But something I don't get... if you really are that strong, why was your major lance's hull so broken when you were coming out of the K.G.C.C.?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You wanna know?

steps.name: Infected Knight-Engineer
steps.text: So long as you don't blow up the story too big, I'll hear you out. I wanna know how you use it, principally.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ha. Where should I start, then—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Back when I was still readying to be a campaign knight, this lance was drawn up for the real battlefield, designed to open the way for the forces behind.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: My major lance takes a tremendous amount of force and impact, multiple times over.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: After the way's opened up, I'd switch over to a minor lance.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But, ever since I started in the arena, I've never let this big thing break.

steps.name: Infected Knight-Engineer
steps.text: In other words... you haven't used your full strength, because you don't actually want to take anyone's life?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: In those grimy underground arenas...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Whether it's orders blaring at top volume or captions on the screen, it's all pushing me to do vicious work on someone, and they don't call it a win until they see every other Infected on the ground...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I never once seriously injured 'em before.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But when I finally clawed my way to being a competition knight, I heard what those old nobleheads were saying about me in the lounge...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Well, I hadn't treaded the ground in a long, long time. Took out my minor lance, aimed it right at the armor over those acid-spitters' hearts—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You understand? I was really, actually hoping to run them straight through.

steps.name: Infected Knight-Engineer
steps.text: Cheers to that. Would've been feel-good!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Feel-good nothing. Just give my pet a look already!

steps.name: Infected Knight-Engineer
steps.text: Oh, right...

steps.name: Infected Knight-Engineer
steps.text: Examination's done. This is an old Raythean model... and it shouldn't be too complicated to reboot it.

steps.name: Infected Knight-Engineer
steps.text: But it's got fairly limited capability. It probably won't understand your commands too well.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I'm good as long as it knows its own name.

steps.name: Infected Knight-Engineer
steps.text: Name? What will you name it?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I decided a long time ago—I'm calling it Justice Knight. Here's hoping it's a little doer of a pet.

steps.name: Infected Knight-Engineer
steps.text: Its original function was cover fire, it seems.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Well, isn't that peachy? It'll clean up nobodies for me. More boring than I'd like for a function, though. Can you make it more useful?

steps.name: Infected Knight-Engineer
steps.text: Depends whether there's any other compatible modules it can make use of...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You need to find other parts to fit? Leave it for later, then. Let's see if we can get to light up first?

steps.name: Infected Knight-Engineer
steps.text: Taking a look now...
(Sound of machine activating)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ooh, there it goes.
